inputs.text: [excited] It was 0.77 meters long — [quickly] like a big cat stretched out! Standing up, it was only 0.3 meters tall — it would come up to your knees! And it weighed barely 1 kilo — [gently] light as a small bird.
[curious] That tiny, and still a carnivore?
[playful] Yes. [proud] Tiny but it ate anything — lizards, fish, small animals.
